# No dynamic allocation in slave

`malloc`, `calloc`, `realloc`, `free`, `aligned_alloc`, `posix_memalign`, `mmap`, `sbrk`, and all variants are banned in `slave/` source. This applies to both profiles (marine and space) and is required by:

- ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 (S18 in standards matrix)
- MISRA C:2023 advisory rule set
- ISO 26262:2018 part 6 (referenced in `docs/research/phase-0-system-requirements.md` §3.3)

## Banned identifiers

```c
malloc       calloc       realloc       free
aligned_alloc  posix_memalign  mmap  sbrk
operator new (in any future C++ bindings)
```

## Approved patterns

- Compile-time sizing via the generated header `tethys_static_memory.h` derived from `transport_max_burst_loss` + A2L `MAX_DTO` (see [`docs/adr/drafts/adr-0005-no-dynamic-allocation.md`](../../docs/adr/drafts/adr-0005-no-dynamic-allocation.md)).
- Static / file-scope arrays sized by `TETHYS_ODT_BUFFER_SIZE`, `TETHYS_CTO_RX_SIZE`, etc.
- Stack allocation for short-lived scratch buffers, bounded by a static `assert()` on `sizeof()` at compile time.

## CI enforcement (lands in PR-4)

`misra-gate.yml` workflow runs:

```bash
rg -n -w 'malloc|calloc|realloc|free|aligned_alloc|posix_memalign|mmap|sbrk' slave/
```

Any match (other than a comment line that documents the ban) fails the build.
